final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- input pair + tail ----
M1  fa   vinp tail vss nfet W=30 L=0.25
M2  fb   vinn tail vss nfet W=30 L=0.25
M0  tail ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=0.5 m=30
* ---- PMOS fold current sources (300uA each) ----
M3  fa   vbp  vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.5 m=30
M4  fb   vbp  vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.5 m=30
* ---- PMOS cascodes ----
M5  x1   vbpc fa   vdd pfet W=5 L=0.4 m=9
M6  vout vbpc fb   vdd pfet W=5 L=0.4 m=9
* ---- NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror ----
M7  x1   vbnc sa   vss nfet W=3 L=0.5 m=7
M8  vout vbnc sb   vss nfet W=3 L=0.5 m=7
M9  sa   x1   vss  vss nfet W=16 L=0.5
M10 sb   x1   vss  vss nfet W=16 L=0.5
* ---- bias network ----
MB1 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
MB2 vbp  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=0.5 m=2
MB3 vbp  vbp  vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.5 m=2
MB6 vbpc ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
MB5 vbpc vbpc pb   vdd pfet W=3 L=0.4
R1  vdd  pb   30k
MB8 vbnc vbp  vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.5
MB7 vbnc vbnc nb   vss nfet W=1.4 L=0.5
R2  nb   vss  30k
.ends
